lines.cobblemon.species.eevee-gmax.desc: Gigantamax energy upped the fluffiness of the fur around Eevee's neck. The fur will envelop a foe, capturing its body and captivating its mind.
lines.cobblemon.species.eevee.desc: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.
lines.cobblemon.species.eevee.name: Eevee
